title: Maximum Sum Circular Subarray
description:
Given a circular integer array, return the maximum sum of a nonempty contiguous segment. A segment may wrap from the end to the beginning, but it may use each array element at most once.

## Examples

```text
Input: nums = [1,-2,3,-2]
Output: 3
```

```text
Input: nums = [5,-3,5]
Output: 10
```

## Constraints

- `1 <= nums.length <= 3 * 10^4`
- `-3 * 10^4 <= nums[i] <= 3 * 10^4`
